messages:
ginny: heads up 10 the mkdocs migration broke a few anchors — emoji in headings are showing up percent-encoded in fragments and linkcheck fails.
pat: can you paste one example?
ginny: sure — in docs/guides/ops.md we have `## Deploy checklist 🚀` but the link from the sidebar goes to /guides/#%F0%9F%9A%80-deploy-checklist and 404s.
lee: yep i've seen that. old slugifier kept the emoji in the slug, new one strips them. two quick fixes: backfill explicit ids or normalize slugify at build-time.
ginny: i started a tiny script to append `{#deploy-checklist}` to headings with non-ascii. small PR incoming.
pat: good short-term. longer-term we should add a linter rule to warn on emoji in headings and update the redirect-map generator to dedupe fragments.
mkdocs-bot: LINKCHECK FAILED 02: 1 broken fragment -> /guides/#%F0%9F%9A%80-deploy-checklist
lee: i'll open a plugin PR that canonicalizes anchors to ascii-only and adds unit tests. once backfill lands we'll run full linkcheck on staging.
ginny: PR 612 opened with backfill for critical guides. leaving thread until plugin + redirect dedupe land and staging linkcheck passes.
pat: thanks all :thumbsup:
